title: Independence of simultaneous generalized eigenspaces for compatible endomorphisms
statement:
Let $K$ be a field [def-weil-field], let $M$ be a $K$-vector space, let $I$ be any set, and let $f_i:M\to M$ be $K$-linear endomorphisms for $i\in I$. For $a\in K$ define
$$E_{i,a}=\{x\in M:\text{there exists }n\geq0\text{ such that }(f_i-a\,\mathrm{id}_M)^n x=0\}.$$
Assume $f_i(E_{j,a})\subseteq E_{j,a}$ for every $i,j\in I$ and $a\in K$. For each function $\lambda:I\to K$ put $W_\lambda=\bigcap_{i\in I}E_{i,\lambda(i)}$. The family $(W_\lambda)_{\lambda:I\to K}$ is independent: for every finite set $S$ of pairwise distinct functions $I\to K$ and every choice $x_\lambda\in W_\lambda$ for $\lambda\in S$, the equality $\sum_{\lambda\in S}x_\lambda=0$ implies $x_\lambda=0$ for every $\lambda\in S$. No finite-dimensionality, algebraic-closedness or commutativity of the endomorphisms is assumed beyond the stated preservation condition.
